# Agentic First

Canonical site:

- https://agentic-first.co/

Alternate domain:

- https://agent-first.co/ redirects to https://agentic-first.co/

## What This Repo Owns

This repo owns the top-level Agentic First umbrella site and route map.
It does not own the Directory implementation or Directory standard
internals anymore.

- Directory product: https://agentic-first.co/directory/
- Directory MCP: https://agentic-first.co/directory/mcp
